description:
You Can Sleep Now | Soft Flute | 3 Hours

Nothing else needs you tonight. You can sleep now.

Three hours of very soft flute music for deep sleep: slow, breathy phrases with long silences, made to fade into the background as your body lets go.

▶ Keep going - the full Sleep Music playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199mx7da__pC4JseKqY856ABr

Perfect for falling asleep, sleeping through the night, quieting the mind at bedtime, deep rest.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri and tanpura drone
Raga: Yaman
Style: Indian instrumental, meditative
Mood: Soft, tender, weightless

⏱ BEST FOR
• Falling asleep

• Deep rest
